name: HackerOne Security Bounty

rewards.summary: Advertised ranges: Low $100–$200; Medium $1,000–$1,500; High $3,000–$7,000; Critical $6,000–$15,000.

eligibility.summary: Program compliance is required for reward eligibility. Employment-exclusive findings and unapproved report sources can be ineligible.

restrictions.summary: Do not access customer programs, environments or data, or unauthorized third-party infrastructure. Encountering sensitive information requires stopping and notifying the program.

limitations: Policy and reward table were reviewed in the browser; static retrieval returned a JavaScript placeholder.
